description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref. 74992/APP/2022/2660, dated 29/03/2023 (Erection of one additional storey above the existing mixed-use building to create 3 no. residential apartments and changes to third floor fenestration.) to alter the proposal description of the approved development
decision_conditions: The information submitted in support of the application seeks to demonstrate that planning permission ref. 74992/APP/2022/2660 was lawfully implemented prior to its expiry and therefore remains extant. The assessment of whether development has lawfully commenced and whether a planning permission remains extant is a material planning matter that falls outside the scope of an application made under Section 96A of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990. As such, the Local Planning Authority is not satisfied that the proposed amendment can be considered a non-material amendment and the application is therefore refused.
